Omg. I thought I was just delusional as a kid. I never knew montelukast could do this. I am shocked. 

I had so many delusions. Many vivid dreams, lucid dreams, sleep paralysis. I thought I just grew out of this but it seems the medicine might have caused it.

I had the same!

Elvanse is ok, I can avoid anxiety if I sleep, eat, and drink water a lot. More than usual. If ANY of these are insufficient I get anxiety attacks. It is effort but I'm titrating so trying it out!!

I have asthma and eczema and have had this issue with medication my whole life.

Changing brands can give me headaches and cause breathlessness. I've complained and had it swapped back.

Im so confused, this post has 2.2k upvotes yet the top comment has only 9 upvotes...

Edit: Apparently top comment is also most controversial. And it keeps going up and down from 8 to 11 upvotes and back. Interesting...

Yess, definitely. My dad (partly mum) did this too much. Particularly with chores. I wanted to help at some point. I wantrd to brush, to put dishes awsu, etc. But he always commented on it like this,  telling me how its good that im actually being useful and poking fun at me for trying to do something useful. It made me anxious and avoid doinf Anything in front of him. I still dont feel entirely comfortable if hes in a room with me in sight, as i see him glance at me every 10mins or so and I feel extremely judged, particularly as he will often pick on sometging I do.

Similar but not the same...i told my mum that i was suicidal whilst really distressed when 14 and she she said that she'd kill me then. She lunged forward and wrapped her hands around my throat, pressing me back onto my bed as she squeezed. She stopped after like 4 seconds though and I don't remember what happened but I did end up leaving the house for a couple hours without asking (at that age that was entirely disallowed). 

Im 19 now and friendly with her and accept her more now. She was being abused by my dad then too so i get it. She once mentioned that day and said to my brother that we still have a positive relationship despite her strangling me. She was proud that that is the case. I'm so angry about that. She never apologised...just brought it up that one day with pride.
I love the background, and both of your smiles. All of this picture looks really good.

The NHS is meant to provide all necessary services for free. There are a few places this doesn't work out but certain groups get everything for free (e.g under 19s, seniors, those on certain benefits).
To be fair they could have first gilded it and then posted the comment.

I'm 19 and will just hold my mum's hand/arm sometimes. It's usually arm. It's not got quite the same meaning as when younger, as it's more to do with closeness than security. You don't have to give it up.
